Luke Foster thought he was doomed when he awakened as a Dragon Tamer, the most useless hidden profession in existence. Dragons are so rare and powerful that for eight centuries, no Dragon Tamer has ever succeeded in taming a dragon. But without one, he can't even unlock his basic skills, leaving him powerless in a world ruled by fighters. Then everything changes after Luke activates the Super Treasure Map System. The mysterious system leads him to the ultimate prize: a real dragon egg! And so, this "weak" Dragon Tamer is about to flip the world upside down.

(Source: Tappytoon)

name.full: Gui Qi Shuang Dao Kan Shang Tian

description:
His body has different abilities, but he has not found any way to use them in the real world. All he can do is to be a professional killer. But at least after going to a different world, where there is only fighting or death in the battlefield its strength will appear differently. His name is Tang Yin...

(Source: WebComics)

A tragic young girl whose mother died giving birth to her.
A wicked stepmother and three brothers with whom she shares no blood ties.
Murderous intent born from avarice and twisted emotions.
Secrets woven with betrayal, terror, deceit, love, death and vengeance.
All buried deep within Ayesha's Forest, shrouded in darkness...

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Zhou Mingrui possessed and reborn Klein Moretti who committed suicide due to the sealed artifact "Antigonus Family Notes". Zhou Mingrui once again held a "Transfer Ceremony" in order to return to Earth, but accidentally entered a mysterious gray fog space. During this process, he inadvertently pulled the consciousnesses of Audrey Hall and Alger Wilson into the gray fog space. In order to dominate the conversation and pretend to be a hidden existence in recovery, Mr. Fool, who calls himself Mr. Fool, has since embarked on a magnificent legend of becoming a god.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

I backhand giving you a scheme, sweeping the invincible hand in the immortal world, just ask is there anyone else? Fronting is like the wind; always by my side! The front road is long; and only fronting may be my friend! Life and death are bearish; !
"Young people, when I started the routine, you are still wearing open pants!"
Xu Que is on the road of scheming, not every day, or on the way to the scheme!

(Source: WebNovel)

Linley is a young noble of a declining, once-powerful clan which once dominated the world. He has large aspirations and wants to save his clan. Linley's journey begins with an accident when he discovers a ring. He took a liking to this ring, which had a dragon carved coiling around it. Upon being injured during a battle between two powerful fighters he discovers that his ring is not what he thought it was and possesses powers beyond his imagination.

Set up and killed by his best buddy, a top-notch swordsman wakes up finding himself turned back into his teenage self.
Restarting again from the weakling bullied by all, he is determined to seek revenge and cherish the girl who once sacrificed her life for him.

(Source: Mangatoon)

A mysterious seal introduces male protagonist Lin Dong to the art of cultivation, and he travels across the lands in order to hone his skills. He meets two vastly different women in Ling Qingzhu and Ying Huanhuan on his adventures, and gets romantically entangled with both.

Through sheer grit and determination, Lin Dong eventually becomes one of the most powerful and respected cultivators. As Lin Dong’s powers increase, so does his knowledge of the world’s deadliest secrets. He soon discovers the demon sect’s plot to take over the world, and the three youths join forces with the righteous martial artists to defeat all evil and return peace to the land.

(Source: Webnovel)

Elias Bai, Captain of God's Legion, stood as the world's strongest Awakener until a brutal betrayal claimed his entire squad. Dying as a mere pawn of the ruling elite, he suddenly wakes up twenty years in the past—back in middle school, long before his awakening. With his loved ones still alive, Elias refuses to let history repeat itself. To save his team, exact vengeance on the traitor, and overthrow the corrupt system, he must walk a lonely road to unrivaled power.

(Source: WEBTOON)

It's thrilling to torture the bad guys. If you keep torturing them, you'll get more fun. A story in which the herorine Su Lüxia and the supporting female character travel through tens of thousands of small worlds together to show countless bastards and bitches who are overwhelmed in various ways.

(Source: Webnovels)

title.romaji: Wangyou: Shen Ji Cike, Wo Ji Shi Anying
title.english: God-Tier Assassin: I Am the Shadow
title.native: 网游：神级刺客，我即是暗影

description:
The mysterious game God’s Forsaken has descended upon Earth. In this world, players can gain lifespan by slaying monsters—and even better, they can expend that lifespan to manifest their in-game powers into reality! As supernatural abilities awaken, global chaos and disasters follow in their wake. In his previous life, Qin Feng fought tooth and nail to protect his sister, Qin Xiaoyou, eventually rising to become one of the top 100 powerhouses in the world. However, his devotion was met with the ultimate betrayal. Blinded by her obsession with a celebrity idol, his own sister gouged out his eyes to steal his "Ancient God’s Eyeballs" as a gift for her star. Now, reborn and sent back to the very beginning, Qin Feng has returned. This time, he will trust no one. Embracing the darkness, he chooses to walk the path of a god-tier assassin to become the strongest—alone!

(Source: WebComics)

This is a school love story where Yi Lin bumps into the tomboy Ruo Xi, sparking an interest between each other that slowly blooms. "Is that true? I, fall in love with a girl?" "Why every time I saw her my heart is beating faster?" "How many times does she notice my burning face?" Yi Lin and Ruo Xi both need an answer to go on.

(Source: Webcomics)

title.english: Reincarnation of the Strongest Sword God

description:
Shi Feng was a top player in the online game “God’s Domain” until he was betrayed by his own guild. After a night of drinking to cope with his sorrows, Shi Feng woke up to find himself returned ten years into the past… when “God’s Domain” had just been released. With his past memories and his ten years of game knowledge, Shi Feng will start a new journey back to the pinnacle. This time, he will not be beholden to anyone else. This time, he will climb to even greater heights than before.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wo de Shiwu Kan Qilai Hen Keai
title.native: 我的食物看起来很可爱

description:
A vampire that has been asleep for almost two hundred years, Maria, has been awakened by a wolf girl passing by, Xing Lan. When the casket was opened, a curse fell upon Xing Lan. Instead of being scared, the naïve Xing Lan instead believes she has found an amazing companion, and the two embark on a journey to the city. The story begins like this.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.english: Soul Land 2: The Unrivaled Tang Sect
title.native: 斗罗大陆2 绝世唐门

description:
A new, proud generation of heaven’s chosen has been born. Can the new generation of Shrek’s Seven Devils rally the Tang Sect and once more compose the song of the Unrivaled Tang Sect?

(Source: Wutopia Comics)

name.full: Jueshì Tang Men Manhua Chuangzuo Zu

description:
I had yearned for the tranquility of the countryside, but destiny had other plans. Suddenly, I found myself transported to an entirely new world. Within Novice Village, I ascended to the status of a creation-level entity. And then, against all odds, I defeated the Demon Empress who ruled this realm—with only a dog I had raised by my side. From that pivotal moment, the defeated Demon Empress took up residence in my humble home, and my extraordinary adventure in this otherworldly domain began.

(Source: Webnovel)
The funny, daily life of a young adult couple.

"Ding! The host has activated the Field of Invincibility! You will be unbeatable as long as you remain within the field!"

A shut-in by the name of Chen Chang'an was transported into a fantasy world, and he swore not to leave the Field of Invincibility until he became an immortal after being endlessly pursued by countless demons and monsters. In the meantime, while he was bored, he took in a few cute and adorable disciples. He accidentally turned them into big shots of the cultivation world and turned it upside down.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Decades have passed since the Earth's magnetic poles disappeared, changing the balance forever. As the last remnants of humanity huddle in their bases, the remaining lifeforms have mutated into so-called xenogens and taken over the outside world.

In the midst of this war for life or death, a sentient mushroom lived his little life in the forest. That is, until humans came and took something precious from him — his spore. With his life's purpose gone, the young xenogen is ready to risk his life to reclaim it. So, donning a dead boy's face and calling himself An Zhe, the little mushroom makes an attempt to infiltrate a human base.

To get inside, he must first get past the Supreme Judge Lu Feng, whose job it is to detect and kill any mutants who try to sneak through the gate. It is said that nothing can escape his cold sight, which is now locked on An Zhe...

(Source: Aloha Comics)

Note: Silver Award winner at the 12th Chinese Nebula Awards for Chinese Science Fiction.

On a certain day, Song Shuhang accidentally joined a deeply afflicted Xianxia chuunibyou(Year 2 middle school disease) chat group, the group members inside all address each other as ‘fellow daoist’. Their contact cards are all either Sect Master, Cave Master, Spiritual Master or Heavenly Expert. Even the group master’s missing pet dog named Great Devil Dog abandoned his home. They chat all day about things like concocting pills, intruding mysterious territories, martial arts experiences and more.

One day, he abruptly realizes after lurking for a long time that…… In this group, every single group member is actually a real cultivator, with the ability to move mountains and drain seas, the kind that can live for thousands of years!

Ah ah ah ah, his worldview has utterly collapsed in a single night!

Tianyu Lin is the leader of the student council's Discipline department. Meanwhile, Ze Xu is a new first year senior high student. During a routine inspection, Tianyu discovers someone sleeping in the last row near the window. He walked over and have him a demerit. Who knew that this demerit would result in them giving their lives to each other...

(Source: WebComics)

Computer game programmer, Xander Song spends his days suffering under his abusive boss and cruel coworkers. Tasked with debugging a new video game called “New Realm,” Xander instead transforms the bugs into easter eggs for only the worthiest of players to uncover. One fateful day, reality rewrites itself and merges with “New Realm.” Thrust into a whole new world, Xander must find his way among desperate players while beating dangerous bosses. Will Xander’s knowledge of the game be enough to survive? Or will it be GAME OVER before he knows it?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Become the Castellan in Another World

description:
When a gamer and homebody starts the BUFF for traveling through time and space, he certainly chooses to make waves! Make waves! And make waves! Domineering cat lady, Lori fox lady, Girly rabbit lady…This is not a Zoo! This is a fantastic Another World under the rule of the law of the jungle! In a real strategic game and a huge conspiracy crisis, the Overlord of Another World is emerging, with the rest nothing but losers…

(Source: Webnovel)

name.full: Lou Xiao Yue Tiantian Bu Gaoxing

description:
Transmigrating into the world of Tianxuan, he became the master of a weak martial sect! The notorious pay-to-win player was reborn inside the world of his favorite game. He'll make the other players into his underlings and take on the game's main character as his apprentice. In this universe, he's going to make a name for himself as the No. 1 in the world!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

In the multiplayer online game Glory, Ye Xiu, is well known as the Textbook level expert and a top-tier player. Due to a series of circumstances, he was forcefully expelled out of his professional team. After leaving the pro gaming scene, he resides at an Internet Café employed as one of the managers. When Glory launches the tenth server, he throws himself into the game once more, equipped with ten years of gaming experience, memories of the past and an incomplete self-made weapon. His journey back to the top begins.
After plotting and scheming, who took away my glory? Under the influence of the storm, my hopes will never be shattered. In its magnificence, the path will not be lost, for I, will return!
The manhua is based on the popular Quan Zhi Gao Shou novel by Butterfly Blue. The manhua is currently serialized digitally in Da Jiao Chong’s mobile application and is released on a weekly basis.

title.english: Return of Cultivator: Vision of Eighty Millenniums

description:
The God of Cosmos was framed and persecuted after he failed in the competition over the crown of the lord. No one would expect he could come back to life 80 thousand years later. This time his soul was accidentally bound with Yang Chen, the son of a servant. Unfortunately, Yang Chen, the original body owner, was the worst at cultivation. How could the God of Cosmos start his revenge planned for 80 millenniums? The answer is, of course, cultivation!

(Source: MangaToon)

Betrayed by her fiancé, Anran Xia (Ariana) flees her wedding, her heart broken and frozen to even the thought of love. Still she rises to the top, as this charismatic beauty buries herself in work. But when her childhood friend suddenly moves back to town, he cheekily creates ripples in her otherwise peaceful life—and in her own home! She’s never imagined being with him, while he’s never imagined being with anyone but her. Can he melt the ice of her long-guarded heart? Sweet romance is on its way!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes two prologues and two epilogues, one per season, and 18 extra chapters.

title.romaji: Kuai Ba Wo Ge Dai Zou

description: What's your brother like? To Miao, her brother Fen is someone who would tease her and make her explode 100 times a day; not a peaceful day as the two are fighting every single minute. However, when troubles come, Fen will become a caring, loving brother who protects his little sister at all cost.

It has been a year since Li Fu Chen lost his “Talent”. Now he lives the life of a trash, being bullied and beaten by those who once was inferior to him. However, he still has not lost everything as he’s still engaged to a strong and pretty girl of a powerful family, but that came to an end as the engagement was abruptly cancelled. With shame brought to the family and his life engulfed by darkness, a ray of hope pierced the the sky.

title.romaji: Shizun: Zhege Chong Shi Nitu Cai Bu Shi Shengzi
title.native: 师尊：这个冲师逆徒才不是圣子

description:
A hundred years ago, Chu Xiu transmigrated to the Empyrean Continent and rose as a fearsome villain—only to be hunted down and destroyed. Reborn with his memories intact, he's done playing the glaringly obvious bad guy. This time, Chu Xiu will grow stronger in the shadows, posing as a righteous hero admired by all while secretly manipulating fate itself. With a gamelike system at his side and a new strategy in mind, he'll rewrite his doomed future. After all, the most dangerous villain is the one no one sees coming.

(Source: Tappytoon)

name.full: Mai Caipiao Bi Zhong Yidengjiang Zhi Xia

description:
The acclaimed financial reporter Sylvie Jaine is cheated on? No way she'd sit back and watch that scumbag and his sweet-faced side piece ride off into the sunset! But when she sees that mistress's uncle's luxurious Rolls-Royce, she has an idea: she'll go after the CEO herself! So this bastard wants to take a shortcut to success? No problem. Watch her become their aunt-in-law instead!

(Source: Webcomics)
The sequel to Feng Shen Ji.

One night a mysterious and unexplained phenomenon occurs in the nine provinces. Five years later Chu Feng, a regular outer disciple of the Azure Dragon school, awakens one of the mysterious nine lightning beasts. And discovers an egg sealed inside him.

Back in high school, Xun An and Yang Muli’s relationship fizzled out before it even had a chance to begin. After graduating college, they reunite back at their old high school, but this time as teachers. As they rekindle their long-lost affection for one another, secrets from their days as high schoolers also begin to emerge... A love story between a gifted, but devious math teacher and a passionate, but hot-headed P.E. teacher.

(Source: Comikey)

Note: Chapter count includes 22 extra chapters.

title.romaji: Wo De Tudi Dou Shi Da Fanpai

description:
When Lu Zhou wakes up one morning, he finds himself in a rather prickly situation. He has become the most powerful and the oldest villain in the world. He has nine disciples, each of whom has a full record of misdeeds. His first disciple is the head of the Nether Sect, served by thousands of followers. Known as the Sword Demon, his second disciple kills anyone who displeases him. Having lost his powers, how is he going to discipline his wicked disciples?

“I make a clean sweep of all obstacles wherever I go. Nobody can walk all over me except my master,”

says Yu Zhenghai, his first disciple.

“I can’t rest easy until my master is dead,”

says Si Wuya, his seventh disciple.

(Source: Webnovel)

This is a world full of spiritual power and cultivators. When Wu Fu is reborn as a teenage boy, he just calmly looks up at the sky, because he knows he has embarked on a brand new journey to glory! All he has to do is to eliminate all the enemies of his previous life with his sword!

(Source: Webnovel)

name.full: Wu La La Da Qiu Zhang

description:
Zhi Sang has a secret crush: her brother's college friend Jiaxu Duan. She does everything she can to hide her feelings only to discover he's already noticed. Will she finally find her happy ending when she grows up?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

"To think that once upon a time, I slaughtered immortals, punished demons, and took over the underworld...!"

Gu TianLang was once the infamous emperor of the underworld where he ruled over immortals and demons alike with an iron fist. Keyword here, “was.” When he incurs the wrath of the Heavenly Dao—an ancient ruler who has attained immortality and a demonic higher power—his people turn on him and lay siege to his castle. Surrounded and outnumbered, Gu TianLang gets ruthlessly and publicly stripped of his powers, smote, and dies.

Only, thanks to a mysterious jade, he wakes up 500 years later! Will he be able to exact his revenge on the Heavenly Dao and get his kingdom back?!

(Source: Comikey)

She, the leader of the hidden sect, specializes in poison and assassination. A genius, and a weirdo, in the eyes of others. After dying from an accident, she was reborn in the body of a disfigured lady. Having her identity changed and unable to return to her family, she abandoned them, but, if she doesn't take revenge on those who caused her harm, will she be worthy of the title "The Ghostly Doctor"? As clouds gather, heroes fight to be the strongest! How will she conquer the world in a red robe, and fight among the strong heroes?!

(Source: ReadManhua)

title.english: I Want to Be a Big Baddie

description:
A true villain needs to be ruthless, evil, and self-destructive! After torturing the protagonist to hell and back, they will exit the scene fabulously with a bang as their work is done. Wang Yi was determined to act that kind of villain. Unfortunately… His male lead could read minds. (:з)∠*)
“You mongrel!” Mr. Yi chuckled as he looked down on the novel’s male lead.
Suddenly, a thought bubble filled with cute emojis (⁄ ⁄ ⁄ω⁄ ⁄ ⁄) with the words “You’re so cute…” appeared in front of Qin.
Qin: ?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

The previous life was a peerless genius in the world of immortality. He was killed by 3 celestial beings. He was accidentally reborn to his 20s by the book of heaven. All he wanted to do was to become an immortal and return to the immortal world, and he became the strongest man on the earth, turning his hands into clouds and covering his hands with rain, provoking anyone who defies him! He is the venerable one! The ruler of 3000 worlds! the guy who is 10 000 times better than Thanos! He is Taixuan Taizun! The Great Immortal!

Set in ancient China during the fall of a ruthless empire, bounty hunter Dao Ma breaks his code to protect a child and becomes the hunted. What begins as a routine escort mission turns into an epic fight for survival against assassins, warlords, and the forces of fate.

(Source: Kana)

When Ye Mo woke up, he found that everything around him seemed to be changed - The beautiful master disappeared; he became the abandoned oneby the family; even more, he became the object of being humiliated by a woman standing on the podiumwith his love letter. But these werenot important at all. The most important thing was that he remembered another terrible thing that didn't belong to him...

(Source: WebNovel)

The Douluo federal expedition team found an egg with golden and silver patterns in the Northernmost Land. After detecting, they found signs of life inside. They quickly brought it back to their Institute for incubation. The egg hatched and a human baby came out; at the same time, the Federal Academy of Sciences was unfreezing a silver-haired woman, and a blue-haired young man was found on the waterfront.

(Source: Webnovel)

The world suffered a change, and monsters began to appear. During this new era, a new profession is born. Tame the monsters, raise the monsters and train the monsters. They are the monster trainers. An innocent youth with a dream has been thrown into this golden age. Gao Peng: Even if it’s just a lizard, I’ll make it evolve into a dragon that can soar into the sky!

(Source: Webnovel)

Yi Kui's got everything you could dream of... good looks, charisma, and style. After all, he's secretly a demon on the hunt for the best dreams to feast upon. Yi Kui can't believe his luck when he stumbles upon the new student—shy, sweet Lin You, who also happens to dream the most delectable nightmares. He immediately tries to charm Lin You, but none of his spells are working! Now Yi Kui's gotta beguile him the old-fashioned way... What happens when the boy of your dreams is actually here to devour them?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

title.english: Once Upon a time in Spirit Sword Mountain

description:
In order to find the child chosen by fate, the Spirit Sword Sect has decided to reopen its entrance exam to select talented disciples. Wang Lu, who possesses a rare Spiritual Root that is said to appear once in a millennium, will take on the challenging entrance exam and embark on his unique path of cultivation.

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: I Have a Mansion in the Post-Apocalyptic World

description:
Jiang Chen crossed into the judgment day after the nuclear war, and there was a mess everywhere. In order to survive, Jiang Chen led the refugees to establish a base area and set up a federation. Then carry the judgment day's technology and return to the true world. Change the political structure of the earth, rescue the world in a critical moment, and establish the Great Union of Earth Federation! Expanding the territory and fighting the threat from the sky.

(source: Webnovel)

I keep saying that I don't have any spiritual power, but they won't believe me! The random doorkeeper claims that I'm the greatest martial artist in the world, and they take his word for it! Wake up guys! I'm really not the martial god you're looking for!!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

After his death, Duan Fei regressed 20 years back in time to those key hours before the virus catastrophe was set off. Now he'll have a chance to remedy the regret he has shouldered for those 20 long years. He will utilize all the knowledge he brought back from his previous life to prepare for the oncoming apocalypse. His newly acquired ‘Evolutionary Tree” will help him continue to grow stronger. Duan Fei was just a survivor in his previous life, now he will be the hero and the savior of the world in this life.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

name.full: Tuzi Zhuan Chi Wo Bian Cao

description:
He was away from home for 3 years... and away from his world for 3,000 years.

3 years ago, he fell into a rift, into a world of immortals, where time flew differently. He struggled 3,000 years there to come home, only to find his family... gone. Now a 3,000-year-old monster, will he slaughter his way to the reunion, or... will he have to start all over again?

(Source: MangaToon)

In Jang Lin, the martial arts path cannot be walked for those who cannot awaken the martial spirit. In this world, only those who have a strong fighting spirit can communicate with the heavens and the earth. Born in Linshui, Chen Nan was an unparalleled genius with talent and thought he would become a great fighter in the future. However, Chen Nan was struck by lightning rays while practicing his martial arts and obtaining the spirit of divine battle, which was able to settle. To break the ultimate rule of Jang Lin, Qin Nan didn’t know that his fighting spirit possessed a great secret that would slowly discover mystery as the story continued.

All her life, Elizabeth has been eclipsed by her warmhearted younger sister, who cares for the common people and rejects the privileges of nobility. In contrast, Elizabeth is seen as an out-of-touch aristocrat who loves to throw lavish parties and frequent the royal palace. Although she works hard for the good of the kingdom, her contributions go largely unnoticed because of her unsavory reputation. One of the few people who are willing to give her a chance is the Archduke of Winternight, the “monster of the North.” As a misunderstood soul himself, he feels a special connection to her and opens up his home. And so, Elizabeth moves to the far North, away from the people she’s known her whole life... Will she finally be able to start over with a clean slate? Or will her past stand in the way of her future with the Archduke?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Chapter Count:
Season 1: Prologue + 99 chapters
Intermission: 10 chapters
Season 2: 82 chapters

Note: Based on a Korean novel by the Korean author Nunoiz, the webcomic is drawn by a Chinese artist and was first released in Chinese.

A young man named Yang Fan was betrayed by his girlfriend while he and his sister at death's door, when suddenly, he traveled back to the past. Last time, you guys bullied me and sold me out. This time, with the power of the ring, only the strongest can survive. And I, am the strongest.

I treated you like a brother, so how could you confess to me?! I only wanted to avoid you but I ended up hurting you through an accident. I’m sorry. If I had another chance, I definitely won't run away again. However… That chance came so fast. I suddenly traveled back three years ago and met you again. The you who doesn’t yet know me.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Originally serialized under the title "Bie Dui Wo Biaobai (别对我表白)".

High schooler Li Huowang can close his eyes and be transported to an uncanny world. Over there, he is a medicine primer who will be made into pills by his "Master" at any given time. Meanwhile, in the real world, Li Huowang is living in a mental hospital, unfit to continue school. The doctor told him that the uncanny world is just his hallucinations. What is real, and what is fake? Li Huowang really does not know.

(Source: Webnovel)

While the demons were rising, mankind was about to become extinct. Six temples rose, and protected the last of mankind. A young boy joins the temple as a knight to save his mother. During his journey of wonders and mischief in the world of temples and demons, will he be able to ascend to become the strongest knight and inherit the throne?

title.english: The SSS-Rank Paladin Who Breaks All Rules

description:
The game has become reality. Monsters run wild, and every human gets one shot to awaken a class. When Victor Chase awakens, he pulls an S+ talent—"Blessing of the Holy Angel"—and unlocks a hidden class thought to be worthless: the Paladin! Weapon Blessing. Angelic Blessing. Blessing of Honor. One buff after another, his power skyrockets until even the air itself trembles. So... who said Paladins were trash-tier?

(Source: WebComics)

The delinquent Tong Yang was suspended after getting into a fight on the first day of school. Upon return, he was shunned by all his classmates. The top-scorer Xiao Zhen ran into Tong Yang hidden away crying by himself. Tong Yang tried to act tough, but his bluster only got him beat up instead. But for some reason, Xiao Zhen began to tutor Tong Yang after school, until Tong Yang found out that the boy who fought him that day was Xiao Zhen's little brother...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: The series was originally self-published on Jing Jian’s Weibo blog. Currently releasing on Kuaikan Manhua and Bilibili Manhua since July 31, 2021.

The Great Thousand World. It is a place where numerous planes intersect, a place where many clans live and a place where a group of lords assemble. The Heavenly Sovereigns appear one by one from the Lower Planes and they will all display a legend that others would desire as they pursue the road of being a ruler in this boundless world. In the Endless Fire Territory that the Flame Emperor controls, thousands of fire blazes through the heavens. Inside the Martial Realm, the power of the Martial Ancestor frightens the heaven and the earth. At the West Heaven Temple, the might of the Emperor of a Hundred Battles is absolute. In the Northern Desolate Hill, a place filled with thousands of graves, the Immortal Owner rules the world. A boy from the Northern Spiritual Realm comes out, riding on a Nine Netherworld Bird, as he charges into the brilliant and diverse world. Just who can rule over their destiny of their path on becoming a Great Ruler? In the Great Thousand World, many strive to become a Great Ruler.

(Source: MangaToon)

Despite her notoriety as a tough boss, Ms. Zhou has a soft spot for Zhan Ying. And it's not like Zhan is complaining! On paper, Ms. Zhou is her perfect partner. There's only one problem: nobody in the office can quite nail down whether Ms. Zhou is straight or actually interested in Zhan. Desperate to find the answer for herself, Zhan begins traversing the minefield that is courting her superior.

(Source: Tapas)

Li Nianfan transmigrated into the world of immortal cultivation with a mortal body. After learning that he had no talent for cultivation, he settled down to live an ordinary life. But only to find...

The dog he adopted watched his writing and painting, and became the demon lord that ruled half the world. The tree he planted in the backyard listened to him play and sing, and grew into the world tree that held up the bridge between heaven and earth. A casual conversation enlightened a passing traveler to become the immortal sage that defined the era...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Wan Jia, the protagonist, was killed in the game KOG by a sneak attack from his own teammate and therefore disqualified. However, the moment he left the game, he went back to one year ago, the first day of this game. This time he'll never trust anyone easily! This is for revenge! And more importantly, for winning the game!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Wuxian Shitu Yu Shier Zhan Ji
title.english: The Limitless Apostle and the Twelve Battle Maidens

description: He is recognized as the strongest existence, standing at the top of the world. Wealth? fame? Power? It was not worth mentioning in his eyes. The strongest apostles fled and startled the human continent for the reason: “Don’t get me wrong! Lao Zi came to look for his future wife! ”Yes, it’s a story about the strongest single apostle ever looking for a wife.

Humanity's world was destroyed by the Demon Kings. Stripped of everything, Awakener Ash Si sacrificed himself in a devastating explosion to drag Demon King Voralune, The Glutton, down to hell. Instead of death, he opens his eyes ten years in the past, long before the tragedy occurred. He discovers his powers have awakened early, and surprisingly, he also possesses Voralune’s power of Gluttony. Armed with this advantage, Ash decides to act in advance. With his return, everything in the world seems to be changing...

(Source: WEBTOON)

Mo Nan, an Imperial Preceptor in the Celestial Realm, has returned to his senior high days. To his surprise, there is a dragon within him… What would a powerless person do in the face of bullies: fight or obey them? In his past life, Mo Nan did not fight. But he will not make the same mistake! The distinguished Imperial Preceptor lives his new life at will in the modern world while holding onto one principle: a ruler does not serve one!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

The villain Ling Chen has a history of hate and violence with the hero, Ye Zimu. Out of nowhere, a reset triggered Ling Chen to return to when he was 17 years old! He has a chance to stop the hero in his path, before Ye Zimu grows to become his worst enemy...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Pi Chai Shi Nian, Nüxian Gui Di Qiu Wo Shou Ta Wei Tu
title.native: 劈柴十年，女仙跪地求我收她为徒

description:
After ten years of chopping wood (so tired ಠ╭╮ಠ), female immortals (one after another ╮(￣⊿￣)╭) keep coming to kneel down and beg me to take them as disciples! (´ཀ`」 ∠)

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.english: I Become A Villain In My Novel

description:
Because his work stopped updating, a third-rate author was punished into his own novel. In the novel, he is reborn as the villain, Li Yuguo, battling wits and courage with the hero of the original novel. Unexpectedly, he got to know many "confidants"...

(Source: WebComics)
The sequel to Feng Shen Ji II.

Qin Yu was killed a few hundred years into the future during the apocalypse due to a misjudgment. He then traveled back in time before the apocalypse kick off, relying on his battle hardened apocalypse experience and techniques, Qin Yu rapidly developed into a formidable opponent, passing through hurdles, saving the world all while protecting his beloved sister.

title.english: Rebirth of a Useless Son-in-law in Nirvana

description:
For the sake of finding his missing parents, Qin Li was forced to become mute for ten years to cultivate a technique given to him by a mysterious old man. He was forced to marry into his gorgeous wife's family, but she never treated him well and called him good-for-nothing! But today, those ten years are over! Today, Qin Li is about to change everything!

(Source: WebComics)

The legendary martial master Simon was betrayed by friends and persecuted to death. Three hundred years later, he reborn in an illegitimate child of the royal family who was deceived. With his past powers, Simon again creates his legend in this land. Surely, it must be a revenge and reconquer road filled with blood!

(Source: Mangatoon)

Twins who have lost their parents had their inheritance stolen away by their evil stepmother. But the stepmother's three sons have a special feelings towards their non-blood-related stepsisters. Thus, a story of love and hate will unfold in this old mansion. This is a fairy tale of vengeance and romance.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.english: Soul Land 3: Legend of the Dragon King

description:
With advancements in soul technology, humans on the continent of Douluo conquered the oceans and discovered two new continents. The soul beasts have also been hunted to the brink of extinction by human soul masters. The king of soul beasts awakens in the depths of the Great Star Dou Forest to lead remaining clan members to seek vengeance against humankind! Tang Wulin aspires to be a powerful soul master, but when his martial soul awakens, it turns out to be……, Prodigy of an era, battle of the Dragon King, the legend of the Dragon King henceforth begins.

(Source: Wutopia Comics)

Baili Jin, a fairy who was living in heaven, eating and drinking without a care, broke her Majesty’s colourful, stained-glass plate at her birthday and got banished to the mortal realm. Now she has to begin her adventures in the mortal realm with all of her spiritual powers gone! In order to survive, the former fairy has to deliver take-out....

An endearingly silly fairy, a gentle restaurant manager, a reserved top student, and a hard to resist two-faced girl, let the story of their beautiful friendship and youthful days begin!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Xiao Lang was a young man blessed with a powerful Mystic Soul, but others failed to see its potential. Ridiculed and persecuted for his ""useless"" Soul, he had no choice but to break away from his clan. He would not let anything keep him from achieving his glorious destiny."Even if heaven itself tries to stop me, I'll break through it! Nothing will stand in my way!" Favorite

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Caifu Ziyou Hou, Tamen Xianshangle Zhongcheng
title.english: Perfect Life System: Double Cash for Her Favor
title.native: 财富自由后，她们献上了忠诚

description:
Miles Shen had it all—good looks, money, the works. Then everything collapsed. His family empire crumbled, he went from trust fund kid to drowning in debt, and his materialistic girlfriend kicked him to the curb without a backward glance. Just when he's hit absolute rock bottom, he gets the "Perfect Life System". The rules? Spend money on any girl who likes him enough (affection level over 60), and he gets double his money back! And just like that, Miles is living a life where normal people go broke from spending, but he just keeps getting richer. He's throwing money around like it's nothing, and somehow his bank account just keeps growing!

(Source: WebComics)

No one could ever come close to “Battle God” Ye Qiu’s skills in Glory, a popular game that took the world by storm. His professional team, however, replaced him with another captain, and even seized his account. He was left to start anew at an internet cafe as a manager. When a new District 10 opened up in Glory, he dives back, armed with a decade of experience and an unfinished custom weapon. His path to redemption, filled with strategy and memories, marks his thrilling return to the summit.

(Source: Tapas)

Everyone in the company knows those two women as fierce competitors who fight all the time. But at the company new year's party, they managed to break the ice after a few too many drinks! After that accidental encounter, the sworn enemies begin to have strange feelings about each other…

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Chongzu Zhuzai: Wo Wan De Jiu Shì Tianzai
title.native: 虫族主宰：我玩的就是天灾

description:
300 years ago, rifts containing monsters appeared all over the world. Class changers, who consisted of combat, support, and life-type awakened people, fought against the monsters and protected the people. Out of the four grades of class changers, divine is the rarest, appearing once in a century, which is why all eyes were on Chen Jiang, the first divine class changer in a century. However, expectations were turned into disappointment when he awakened into the most unpopular type, the life type. However, for some reason, Chen Jiang seems quite content with what happened...

(Source: Tappytoon)
Two young boys, feel very anxious to face the circumstances of reality, what kind of decision will they take?

title.romaji: Yinwei Wo Shi Kai Wuqi Dian De Dashu
title.native: 因为我是开武器店的大叔

description:
An average-looking but extraordinarily strong weapon shop owner and a well-behaved but mysterious demon girl. What roles do they play in this ever-changing world?

(Source: Webnovel)

This is an examination that puts your life at stake. Answer a plethora of questions, pass the exam, and you may live. Two-faced examiner, Qin Jiu, meets the cold examinee, You Huo. In this inhumane system, both of them who have lost their memories go head to head against each other. Despite that, they have a strong mutual understanding. Alarms go off and the system collapses time and time again. During which, their memories gradually return. It turns out that even at the end of the world where there's only dust left, you're still the first person I met. What's so great about this system? We'll just destroy it. The world is brilliant and grand still, so welcome home.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)
